bug_info.bug_desc: In the TL-UL read-response data mux, the error blanking condition used reqfifo_rdata.error instead of the actual response error signal d_error. For a read that fails due to an SRAM uncorrectable error, rspfifo_rdata.error is asserted so d_error is asserted, but reqfifo_rdata.error is not. The old expression therefore selected rspfifo_rdata.data instead of error_blanking_data, causing a TL-UL error response to carry the raw memory data rather than the configured error constant. This violates the requirement that read-class error responses return the configured error constant.
bug_info.fix_hint: Use d_error as the condition for selecting error_blanking_data in the d_data assignment. Since d_error already combines both request-side errors and SRAM read-data errors, qualifying the blanking mux with d_error ensures all read error responses return the configured error constant instead of memory read data.
